lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximate vertical columns and horizontal rows. Posterior to the gill region, the spots exhibit a semi-regular grid pattern with inter-blob distance increasing slightly in the posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal lines of blobs, creating a discernible grid-like structure where blobs serve as nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the flank. Each ridge is defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition, with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side of the ridge casting a low-luminance shadow immediately below the ridge line.
